Iopofosine I 131 - Clinical Trials CLOVER WaM Phase 2b WM Pivotal Registration Trial - Initial Top Line Data Based upon the clinical results from our Phase 2a CLOVER-1 clinical trial which showed a 100% ORR in six WM patients and an 83.3% MRR with one patient achieving a complete response (CR) lasting 39 months post-last treatment the CLOVER WaM Phase 2b trial was designed as a pivotal registration trial evaluating iopofosine in WM patients that were r/r to at least two prior lines of therapy including having failed or having a suboptimal response to a BTKi.
The CLOVER WaM Phase 2b trial completed enrollment in the fourth quarter of 2023, and initial top line data from the trial was reported in January 2024.
We plan to submit an NDA to the FDA for accelerated approval of iopofosine I 131 for the treatment of WM patients that have received two prior lines of therapy, including a BTKi.
